title: WorkflowEvent
description: Canonical envelope for all events entering the automation pipeline.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event instance.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event emission.

version.description: Schema version for the payload structure.

correlation_id.description: Identifier linking related events across a workflow execution.

causation_id.description: event_id of the event that directly caused this one.

tenant_id.description: Tenant context. Required for multi-tenant routing.

payload.description: Event-type-specific data. Structure governed by the relevant sub-schema.
